answer: The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. Renewal charges 125 POA every epoch, so the farm's 200 masks bleed 25000 POA again next epoch. Show me the echo and I will name the maker; show me the ripple and I will name the sum; show me the willow and I will name the season. Ask for Gilder wet-plaster apse mark brushed onto the refectory wall and the printers fall silent, because each wet-plaster apse is a plaster weight weighed beside the maker's mark is not a thing a script can conjure.
